{{recipesummary|category=Chicken recipes|servings=4|time=2 hours|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the Mediterranean|Mediterranean cuisine]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 bunch [[Cookbook:Parsley|curly parsley]], washed
* 2 [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallots]], peeled and coarsely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Garlic|cloves garlic]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 3 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 1 tablespoons Italian herb blend
* Juice of 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
* 2 tablespoons [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 whole [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cut up (or any 8 chicken pieces—any combination of leg, breast, thigh, and wing)

==Procedure==

# In a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], combine parsley, shallots, garlic, olive oil, mustard, Italian herb blend, lemon juice, pepper, and salt. [[Cookbook:Purée|Purée]].
# Transfer mixture to a [[Cookbook:Gallon|gallon]] zip-lock bag.
# Add chicken, making sure it's covered on all sides by the [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinade]].
# Seal bag and refrigerate for an hour.
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|300°F]] (150C).
# Transfer chicken pieces to a rimmed [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] about 40 minutes, turning pieces after 20 minutes, until juices run clear.
